# Article Grid

`editorial/article-grid` &middot; section-level &middot; category: editorial

## Purpose

Articles in a grid of 1 to 3 columns with an optional heading and a more-articles button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `articles` | articles |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Two articles across.
- **one-column**: One article per row. Sets `columns: 1`.
- **three-column**: Three compact articles across. Sets `columns: 3`, `cardVariant: minimal`.
- **headlines**: Two across with headlines only. Sets `cardVariant: headline`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileColumns` | one of `1`, `2` | `1` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `columns` | one of `2`, `1`, `3` | `2` |
| `cardVariant` | one of `default`, `minimal`, `headline`, `centered` | `"default"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileColumns`: `1`, `2`. How many columns per row on phones.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Each row is a table with exact widths. mobileColumns is ignored. | Stacking works. Non-Google Gmail accounts show the desktop layout on phones. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('editorial/article-grid', {
  "heading": "From the journal",
  "articles": [
    {
      "title": "How to care for linen so it lasts a decade",
      "excerpt": "Wash it cool, dry it slow, never iron it flat.",
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/560x360/png?text=Care%20Guide",
        "alt": "A linen shirt drying on a line"
      },
      "href": "https://example.com/journal/caring-for-linen",
      "author": "Maya Chen",
      "date": "12 June",
      "category": "Care guide",
      "readTime": "4 min read"
    },
    {
      "title": "Inside the workshop where every shirt begins",
      "excerpt": "A day with the tailors who cut and sew our linen.",
      "image": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/560x360/png?text=Workshop",
        "alt": "A tailor cutting fabric at a long wooden table"
      },
      "href": "https://example.com/journal/the-workshop",
      "author": "Sam Okafor",
      "date": "5 June",
      "category": "Behind the scenes",
      "readTime": "6 min read"
    }
  ],
  "cta": {
    "label": "Read more from the journal",
    "href": "https://example.com/journal"
  }
}) ]]
```
